A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study of non-zero LoRA initialization and provide readable text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. Appendices A–E are retained in v2, which adds Appendix F; their shifted pagination does not prevent reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original toy-model experiments, T5-Base evaluations on GLUE tasks, and Llama 3-8B evaluations on commonsense and arithmetic reasoning, including supplementary experiments in Appendix E.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results in Sections 3–4 and Appendix E. The new Appendix F contains discussion rather than additional experiments.

M1.justification: The non-zero initialization procedure, equal-variance initialization of A and B, and variants with and without subtraction from pretrained weights are unchanged. No algorithm, objective, architecture, or inference component is added.

E1.justification: Both versions use MNIST/FashionMNIST for the toy model, the same four GLUE tasks, and the same commonsense and arithmetic reasoning benchmarks. Appendix F mentions other research fields without evaluating additional datasets or tasks.

E2.justification: The initialization comparisons, starting-point variants, and LoRA+ initialization comparison remain unchanged. BoRA and block/Kronecker approaches are newly discussed in Section 5.1 but are not added to any reported experimental comparison.

E3.justification: Sections 3–4 and Appendix D retain the same models, evaluation procedures, learning-rate and initialization sweeps, sequence lengths, ranks, precision, and training budgets. No existing protocol is revised or new evaluation protocol introduced.

E4.justification: The learning-rate and initialization sensitivity studies, initialization-noise analysis, subtraction ablations, and LoRA+ experiments are retained unchanged in Figures 2–11. Appendix F introduces no supplementary analysis or robustness test.

E5.justification: Both versions report three repetitions for the GLUE experiments, ten independent repetitions with different seeds for the toy experiments, and the same standard-deviation ranges in Section 4. No uncertainty-reporting practice or statistical procedure changes.

E6.justification: All eleven figure images have identical contents across versions, including the appendix heatmaps and LoRA+ results. Table 1 and the textual experimental findings also remain unchanged; no result entries or numerical outcomes are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The definitions, Theorem 1, and derivations in the main text and Appendices A–C are unchanged. The new discussions introduce no mathematical assumptions, propositions, proofs, or corrections.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims: non-zero initialization improves robustness to suboptimal learning rates, and appropriately scaled initialization noise need not harm fine-tuning. The claimed contributions and their scope are unchanged.

C2.justification: The explanations of learning-rate robustness, initialization noise, and performance deterioration at excessive initialization variance are unchanged. Appendix F provides broad research positioning and a prospective direction without revising interpretations of the results or applicability limits.

D1.justification: Appendix D retains the same optimizer settings, hyperparameter grids, preprocessing, precision, and LoRA placement details. The code-access URL is also unchanged, and no new implementation or resource information is supplied.

R1.justification: Section 5.1 adds discussion of BoRA and block/Kronecker approaches to improving low-rank expressivity. New Appendix F connects LoRA with compression, interpretability, and causal reasoning and suggests interpretable LoRA as future work. These additions introduce eleven references while preserving the existing novelty positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds two related-work sentences and the short section 'F. Connection to More Fields.' The existing scientific narrative and Appendices A–E remain unchanged apart from citation-label adjustments and pagination.

P2.justification: The additions reflow the related-work text, Impact Statement, and bibliography, and the appendix figures receive different vertical spacing. Table 1 and Figures 1–11 retain their content, design, numbering, and captions.

improvement.justification: Section 5.1 modestly improves contextual coverage by acknowledging BoRA and block/Kronecker approaches to low-rank expressivity. Appendix F adds only a brief prospective connection to other fields. The gain is limited to research context: the theory, empirical support, technical documentation, and core exposition remain unchanged.
